name: Huacas de Moche mould-based ceramic workshop
description: At Huacas de Moche, potters made moulds and shaped fine ceramic objects in a workshop using local clay. Some workshop moulds have been matched to objects in residences.

date.label: Moche IV context, approximately 400–850 CE
date.basis: Date of the scoped witness or archaeological context, not a claim of origin.

events.statement: The fineware workshop contains moulds and manufacturing traces across three floors assigned to Moche IV.

evidence.supports: The incompletely excavated workshop contained moulds, local clay, production tools and three Moche IV occupational floors; some moulds match products found in site residences.
Moche IV artefacts circulated at the site approximately 400–850 CE; the interval supplies broad phase context rather than direct dates for individual moulds.
The incompletely excavated workshop contained moulds, local clay, production tools and three Moche IV occupational floors; some moulds match products found in site residences.

events.caveats: Dates describe broad circulation of Moche IV artefacts, not direct dating of each mould or the origin of the practice. Organization and patronage are archaeological interpretations.
